sweep.headline: Fix thread placement before touching the partitioner.
actions: Bind threads so consecutive workers share a socket (OMP_PROC_BIND=close, OMP_PLACES=cores).
Read CPU-to-socket mapping from sysfs; do not assume the numbering scheme.
Partitioner choice is worth less than the placement decision at this scale.

sweep.headline: The partitioner is now the lever, and its value grows with p.
actions: Avoid non-contiguous assignments under a two-stage (rank-then-thread) decomposition.
Choose the node count so the unit count divides evenly across first-stage cuts.
Keep thread placement fixed -- its cost has not gone away, it has merely been overtaken.
